Samira Gomez: Hey team, quick question. Im on Redwood plan A and started full-time on 2024-05-15. Had a diagnostic MRI on 2024-04-28 while still contractor (paid OOP). Can we get that count toward my in-network deductible so I dont double-pay? Carrier is ZenithCare (same as Redwood).

Maya - People Ops: Hi Samira  thanks for flagging. Since it's the same carrier (ZenithCare) theres a good chance. Two things: 1) upload the EOB(s) to the Benefits Portal under "Previous Coverage Credit" within 90 days of your effective date, 2) we need a completed ZenithCare Deductible Transfer form. If you want, we can submit the carrier form on your behalf once EOBs are uploaded.

Samira Gomez: Uploaded EOB file: samira_mri_eob_apr2024.pdf. It lists provider claim # and total paid $420.

Benefits Bot: Reminder: Prior coverage credit requests require EOB + carrier form. Docs uploaded at 2024-05-16 10:12AM. Deadline: 90 days from 2024-05-15.

Claims📎: Looping in ZenithCare rep. Well try to attach provider claim # to carrier portal submission. Turnaround 2-4 weeks typically.

Evan - Payroll: If the credit is approved and you paid amounts under RW plan for the same claim, we can process reimbursement for the overlapping portion. Keep receipts for any copays or payments.

Samira Gomez: Thanks! One more q  if provider billed after my effective date but service was before transition (billed late), does that matter?

Maya - People Ops: Good question. Carriers look at service date for deductible credit, not bill received date, so it should be okay. If carrier pushes back, we'll escalate with the provider billing office.

Samira Gomez: Awesome, appreciate the help :heart:
